channel.title: WristVox Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for WristVox Mac

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.0

  • Escape button — when not dictating, the bottom-left button now sends Escape key (stop Claude generation, close dialogs, cancel actions)
  • When dictating, the same slot shows Stop as before — safely stops dictation without toggling
  • New BLE command: Escape (0x1F)
  • Fixed: Stop command correctly uses single Fn press — never accidentally starts dictation
